company: Google
UUID_purpose: Notify-only (properties 0x10) Characteristic of the GSound / "Bisto" Service fe59bfa8-7fe3-4a05-9d94-99fadc69faff - Google's Assistant-on-headphones platform per the BlueZ vendor-UUID thread. Captured on Sony WH-CH720N (handle 151) and Sony WI-SP600N (handle 0x001b) headphones. Its name and payload format are not publicly documented. Note: this entry was also previously classified as a GATT Service by the APK scanner's file-level default; the live GATT captures show it is a Characteristic. Previously attributed in this file to "Inspire Zone" solely because the UUID appears in the decompiled DEX of com.inspirezone.bluetoothpair. That app is a generic third-party Bluetooth pairing utility that embeds other vendors' UUIDs; it is a consumer of this UUID, not its originator, so the company has been corrected. The original APK observation is retained below as evidence because it remains factually true. This attribution rests on the BlueZ identification of the parent Service and is less certain than a vendor-published reference; Sony is the plausible alternative, since both captures to date are of Sony headphones.
